newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to sign 500 mln DM loan with Germany.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to sign 500 mln DM loan with Germany.

text.p: A 500 million mark loan offered to Hungary by the German states of Bavaria and Baden-Wurtenberg will be signed an October 3 in Munich, German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Thursday.

"The loan agreement will be signed when Prime Minister Gyula Horn comes to Munich on Germany's reunification day," Waigel told journalists after meeting Horn and Hungarian Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy.
"This is a right step in the right direction (for Hungary)," Waigel added.

He added that, during the next weeks, there will be further talks about the Hungarian government's energy price rise delay to January 1 from October 1, which also affected German investors in Hungary's energy sector, but did not elaborate.
Waigel is on a two-day visit to Hungary during, which he will meet Hungarian President Arpad Goncz and will attend a German-Hungarian business forum.
